section.label: UI Elements
section.blurb: Buttons, frames, cursors and component kits you can drop into a build.
section.agentHint: Use for concrete assets a developer can install or import, not for visual references.

entries.name: Complete UI Essential Pack
entries.why: Game-ready chrome in one download: buttons, bars, frames, cursors and icons across several palettes. Drops straight into a game or a game-styled web app.

entries.name: Kenney
entries.why: Thousands of CC0 game assets covering UI packs, fonts and audio. No attribution required, which makes it the least risky starting point.

entries.name: shadcn/ui
entries.why: Copy-paste React components built on Radix and Tailwind. You own the code after pasting, so restyling never fights a library upgrade.

entries.name: OpenGameArt
entries.why: Community library of sprites, tiles, interface art and audio. Licenses are set per upload, so check each one before shipping.
